name: 58-google-system-prompt-leftover
description: The system-prompt collection is guarded by `messages.length > 1` (:436), so it can never consume the LAST message of the array. With two leading system turns and nothing else, S1 is shifted into system_instruction while S2 is left behind; S2 then falls through the role fix to 'user' (:462-463) and becomes the only content turn. A port written as `while messages and messages[0].role == 'system'` would consume both and return contents = []. Expected: system_instruction.parts = [{'text':'S1'}]; contents = [{'role':'user','parts':[{'text':'S2'}]}].
